title: patches.json
description: The arbiter's span patches under the one key patches, one object per span it changes. tools/apply-patches.py applies the set only when every patch holds: fix_old is the span's t exactly, a fix_new holding a numeral names its rows in c, and each changed field stays within its word cap. An empty list changes nothing. A patch that takes an allotted evidence clause off the page names it under departures.

fix_old.description: The span's t as it stands.

fix_new.description: The replacement t; empty deletes the span.

c.description: The rows fix_new rests on; [] only on connective text.

departures.description: Each allotted evidence-clause ID a patch takes off the page, with the rule that forced it; apply-patches adds them to departures.json, which brief-check A1 reads.
